say:3:1410454002:0.text: We're here to collect today's Divine Dew on behalf of Lady Celestine.
say:3:1410454002:0.source_cn: 我们代莱索兰大人领取今日的恩典灵露。
say:3:1410454002:0.male: We're here to collect today's Divine Dew on behalf of Lady Celestine.
say:3:1410454002:0.female: We're here to collect today's Divine Dew on behalf of Lady Celestine.

say:7:1410454004:0.text: Indeed. It's a privilege of the nobility. Celestine has no servants, so some daily tasks fall to us.
say:7:1410454004:0.source_cn: 算是贵族的特权。莱索兰没有仆从，一些日常事务就由我们代劳。

say:10:1410454006:0.text: Apologies for the wait, Lady Xera. Here is Lady Celestine's Divine Dew.
say:10:1410454006:0.source_cn: 久等了，席蕾大人，这是莱索兰大人的恩典灵露。

say:11:1410454007:1.text: Thank you. We'll deliver it to her immediately. Merlin, please hold onto it for now.
say:11:1410454007:1.source_cn: 谢了，我们马上送到莱索兰大人手上。梅林，你先拿好。

say:14:1410454008:1.text: The Queen's grace has its preferences. That's why so many scramble to get closer.
say:14:1410454008:1.source_cn: 女王的恩典也会分亲疏远近的，所以才有那么多人挤破了头想过来。
